Hi Amy,

Thanks again for the time on Friday — excited about SunGrid's potential fit with our Dedicated offering for high-volume scoring during origination windows. The procurement and underwriting teams asked if we could connect them with a customer who runs large-batch inference (hundreds of concurrent jobs) and can speak to latency predictability and incident response.

Would a 30-minute call with one or two of your execs + our engineering contact work? Ideally someone who can cover:
- production throughput and observed latency under peak load
- failover / fallback behavior during maintenance events
- any performance tuning (batching/quantization) you found useful

I'm attaching a one-pager that summarizes the ask and a short agenda. If you prefer, share a requirements doc and we can tailor the ask.

Proposed window: Tue/Wed next week (Apr 27–28), 30 minutes. Happy to work around whatever the customer prefers.

Thanks for helping — we want this to be low-friction for the customer.

Best,
Ben
